recuperacao-senha.label: Password recovery
recuperacao-senha.context: Users cannot reset their passwords on mobile devices. The email link does not open the native app, and support is receiving many tickets about it.
recuperacao-senha.requirements:
The reset link works in the mobile app and browser.
The link expires after 24 hours.
The user keeps data from the active session.
Support iOS and Android.

onboarding-b2b.label: B2B domain validation
onboarding-b2b.context: B2B onboarding produces inconsistent registrations because the company email domain is not checked during sign-up. Operations reviews each registration manually.
onboarding-b2b.requirements:
Validate the domain format before proceeding.
Block generic domains such as Gmail and Hotmail.
Show a clear error without losing entered data.
Log invalid attempts for analysis.

filtro-busca.label: Combined search filters
filtro-busca.context: Users cannot filter results by category and price range at the same time. Applying one filter clears the other and causes users to abandon the search.
filtro-busca.requirements:
Combine filters without resetting earlier selections.
Update results without reloading the page.
Keep active filters in the URL for sharing.
Add a button to clear every filter at once.

notificacao-pagamento.label: Payment confirmation
notificacao-pagamento.context: Customers do not receive confirmation after an approved payment. Many contact support because they think the payment failed, creating unnecessary work.
notificacao-pagamento.requirements:
Send a confirmation email with a payment summary within two minutes.
Include a receipt link in the email.
Send an app push notification if the user has enabled notifications.
Log sending failures so they can be retried.
